It's May 30, 1980, and I'm sitting here in my room in the Hyatt Hotel in New Orleans, Louisiana, continuing our chat with my dear friend, Danny Barker.
Hey, Danny, we just got through talking about one band that you played with in New York there. Who else did you play with around there?
